review_basis: All 333 pypdf occurrences reviewed with complete sentences and preserved neighboring text; exact stop-end labels separated. The 509 pages were independently extracted, not all newly read or visually observed. Paired-reader semantic binding is verified separately.

incentive_plan_revision.meaning: References to revised incentive-plan drafts. Preserve conditional or future option/grant adjustments; not a revision of recipient dividend terms.

regulatory_revision.meaning: Edition of a quoted regulatory rule. A quoted rule revision is not itself a distribution amendment; associated risk-warning declarations remain source statements.

offering_scheme_revision.meaning: Revision of a share-offering or acquisition scheme; retain approval stage and offering-price scope.

conversion_price_current.meaning: Current convertible-bond conversion-price pair. It is not recipient cash or a stock-halt declaration.

conversion_price_history.meaning: Historical conversion-price reset or reference notice; retain historical effective dates and the explicit source-year discrepancy.

warning_removal_objective.meaning: Objective or conditional future application to remove risk warnings. The warning is not declared removed.

hshare_auditor_reference.meaning: External-auditor change in the title of a referenced Hong Kong meeting notice. Preserve H-share scope; the referenced notice is not newly obtained or certified.

hshare_charter_reference.meaning: Charter revision in a referenced Hong Kong meeting-notice title. No A/H-share payment terms are inferred.

future_transaction_resolution.meaning: Supplementary board resolution to be made after transaction work finishes; not an already-issued dividend correction.

negated_correction_statement.meaning: Issuer states previously disclosed information does not need correction or supplementation. Preserve negation and any control-change exception; this does not certify archive completeness.

investment_project_delay.meaning: Delay of IPO-funded investment projects. It is not a dividend-payment or securities-resumption delay.

distribution_revision_reference.meaning: Implementation notice explicitly cites the September 24, 2026 Daqin half-year cash revision. Bind to the prior original/revised review, preserve 0.08008 recipient cash versus 0.08000 ex-reference cash; accept no new field.

capitalization_projection.meaning: Post-capitalization share-total projection, subject to final registration and fractional-share treatment. Not a completed share-credit event.

corporate_filing_procedure.meaning: Authorization for later corporate-registration changes based on distribution implementation; not an entitlement date.

distribution_capital_base.meaning: Source-declared capital-base change or eligible-share calculation after cancellations/repurchase exclusions. Financially relevant context retained; cash, dates and account treatment are not accepted here.

payee_name_change.meaning: Self-paid shareholder entity name changes, not a change to the issuer security name or recipient cash.

repurchase_scheme_change.meaning: Repurchase price cap/funding changes. In c020 the antecedent is the 58.00 to 57.50 price-cap adjustment and estimated repurchase quantities; other terms remain unchanged.

offering_limit_after_capitalization.meaning: Completed capitalization is recalled to update a private-offering quantity limit. Retain retrospective scope; not a new distribution instruction.

historical_buyback_termination.meaning: Historical termination of the repurchase scheme after its minimum amount was met; not cancellation of a dividend.

risk_warning_name_change.meaning: Source-declared issuer security-name/risk-warning change. This review does not integrate a historical ST interval or confirm a market opening.

incentive_plan_termination.meaning: Termination of incentive plans/associated assessment rules, with restricted-share cancellation context. Distinguish completed decisions from conditional repurchase steps; not termination of a distribution.

conditional_transaction_termination.meaning: Conditional deadline consequence or possible M&A termination risk. Not a statement that termination has occurred.

no_control_change_statement.meaning: Express statement that the transaction will not change the actual controller; preserve the negation.

no_delisting_intent.meaning: Tender offer does not aim to terminate listing. This is intent wording, not a guarantee about future listing status.

merger_regulatory_approval_reference.meaning: Quoted regulatory approval covers shareholder/equity changes for the merger entities. Approval does not prove completion of the merger or actual stock tradability.

control_change_reference.meaning: Control-change proposal, progress, condition or reference. Preserve the full sentence, approval/registration conditions and any negation; do not infer completed ownership transfer. c234 has a reader-order/page-boundary issue separately inspected in the original pages.

stop_end_column_label.meaning: Exact compound column label 停牌终止日. The word does not terminate a dividend. No instrument, date, restart or opening acceptance is inferred from the column label.
